topic: Why do traffic jams happen with nothing blocking the road?
title: Why Do Traffic Jams Happen With Nothing Blocking the Road?
description:
Sometimes a highway jams with no accident, no construction, nothing blocking it at all - and physicists can prove it. One driver's small brake tap forces the next car to brake harder, and that wave rolls backward through traffic all on its own. Up next: why starling flocks turn together with no leader. #traffic #physics #science #phantomtrafficjam
